evidence.claim: The companion records adapter-only training, save, fresh-process reload, and held-out generation on CUDA and Apple Silicon.
The bounded CUDA lifecycle audited distinct one-row train, validation, and test splits with explicit source groups and content-addressed raw-to-prepared lineage.

corpus_audit.boundary: This tiny qualification split proves the audit path, not broad corpus quality, transcript accuracy, or distribution rights.

evidence.claim: Fresh-clone CUDA adapter training completed on a bounded run.
A bounded MPS adapter step completed.
The current public CUDA path completed one BF16 LoRA update with finite training and validation losses.

training.boundary: Bounded runs do not establish convergence or long-session stability.

evidence.claim: The CUDA run saved adapter state and exercised merge behavior.
The selected checkpoint was reduced to inference-only adapter files and archived with an exact SHA-256.
LoRA Trainer checkpoints expose independent model, optimizer, scheduler, trainer, and RNG state members required by evaluator 0.45.

checkpoint_save.boundary: The selected inference adapter is retained, but no real interrupted run validates numerical guarded-resume equivalence.

evidence.claim: A fresh process reloaded the bounded MPS adapter.
Fresh CUDA processes reloaded the archived adapter during lifecycle inference, evaluation, and two package restores.

fresh_process_reload.boundary: Fresh reload is validated for one adapter and model revision, not every checkpoint or runtime.

evidence.claim: The reloaded MPS adapter generated a finite held-out WAV.
The reloaded CUDA adapter generated both frozen held-out rows as valid 44.1 kHz WAV files.

held_out_inference.boundary: Two prompts and one seed do not establish perceptual quality, long-form stability, or adaptation benefit.

evidence.claim: Two frozen CUDA rows reached complete plan-required coverage for ASR, speaker, validity, audio, timing, and memory metrics.

evaluation.boundary: Objective proxies are complete for this slice, but no matched Base candidate or blind review establishes quality or improvement.

evidence.claim: The lifecycle publishes a content-addressed final package to a preflight-tested operator-declared persistence root and records a receipt.
One 21,514,240-byte package was retained and restored twice; both restores reproduced the frozen neutral WAV byte-for-byte, and a wrong expected package digest failed before output creation.
The exact CUDA package and 49-file base-model identity restored twice on a second host through MPS; both MPS WAV files were byte-identical.

packaging.boundary: CUDA same-host and Mac second-host restores do not prove independent backup, clean-host portability, disaster recovery, access control, or distribution rights.

evidence.claim: The inherited upstream repository documents a full-SFT path separately from the Instavar LoRA addition.
Single-process full SFT can opt into the guarded checkpoint contract without claiming distributed resume.
The current public CUDA adapter path completed training, fresh reload, two-row objective evaluation, packaging, and two restores.
A bounded MPS LoRA step saved, reloaded, and generated a finite held-out WAV.
The exact CUDA package restored both frozen rows on MPS, with two byte-identical neutral restores and bound two-row ASR and ECAPA diagnostics.
The upstream lineage exposes ONNX CPU inference, but adapter-aware export is not established here.
The upstream lineage exposes SGLang serving, but adapter-aware export is not established here.

blockers: No preregistered matched Base candidate has run against the retained adapter.
No complete criterion-scoped blind review exists.

rights.code: The repository declares Apache-2.0 for its code and bundled model lineage; pin and review every distributed artifact.
rights.weights: Pin and review the upstream model-weight terms separately from this repository's code license.
rights.dataset: Record dataset provenance, permitted use, and speaker consent before training.
rights.generated_output: Review the model and dataset terms for the intended generated-output use.

known_gaps: A one-step MPS preflight does not establish training quality or long-session stability.
The validated CUDA slice has only two prompts, one seed, and one one-step adapter, with no matched Base candidate.
The retained package has CUDA same-host restores and Mac second-host restores but no independent backup or clean-host restore.
The exact MPS package probe covers two prompts and one seed; both outputs differ from CUDA and do not establish runtime equivalence.
Guarded checkpoint resume has dependency-free contract coverage but no real interrupted GPU or MPS continuation comparison.
Existing lifecycle runs predate evaluator 0.45 live-conditioning receipts; a fresh uninterrupted and interrupted-resumed pair is required for the stronger byte-exact claim tier.
Distributed and multi-worker guarded continuation are rejected because rank-local state is not represented.
Adapter-aware ONNX and SGLang exports have not passed conformance.
No selected adapter has passed blinded long-form Singapore English listening.
